query: how to make an ats-friendly resume on iphone without a subscription
lead: Getting past the ATS — the software that scans your resume before a human sees it — is where most applications quietly fail. The catch: most resume builders that promise ATS-safe output want a subscription and upload your personal data to their servers.
detail: An ATS (applicant tracking system) parses your resume into fields, so layout choices matter: tables, text boxes, columns, images and fancy headers can break parsing and get you filtered out. You can build an ATS-safe resume by hand in Pages or Google Docs if you know the rules, but it is easy to trip on them. Your personal data, which a resume is full of, never leaves the device.
